title: UV Autofluorescence Microscopy of Jaw Ground Sections from Seymouria, Broili, 1904, Reveals Clots in Vascular Canals
content:
Abstract
Blood clots found in 40-micron thick sections prepared from the jaws of several tetrapods collected from Richards Spur fissure fills deposits near Fort Sill, OK are described. Clots were examined with brightfield, polarized, and ultraviolet autofluorescence microscopy. Clots formed a tight junction with the hydroxyapatite walls of the bone and were often present in adjoining Volkmann canals. It is believed that the clots were formed by trauma related to asphyxiation, leading to death.
